# YOLO-NAS

**YOLO-NAS** is a [YOLO](ultralytics-yolo.md)-family object detector released by
**Deci AI** in 2023 whose architecture was **generated by neural architecture
search** rather than hand-designed — Deci's **AutoNAC** (Automated Neural
Architecture Construction) engine. Its distinguishing goal is **quantization
robustness**: it is built to lose very little accuracy when compressed to **INT8**
for edge deployment, which is where most hand-tuned detectors degrade.

## Why it matters in this wiki

YOLO-NAS is the **NAS + quantization** data point in the detection lineage — the
version that optimized for *deployment* (INT8 on edge accelerators) rather than
raw architectural novelty. It sits in the [YOLO version lineage](../syntheses/vision/yolo-version-lineage.md)
between the hand-designed CNNs (v5–v8) and the transformer line
([RT-DETR](rt-detr.md)), and is one of the model families shipped in the
[Ultralytics](ultralytics-yolo.md) back-catalog.

## Key facts

- **NAS-designed:** produced by Deci's **AutoNAC** search, not manual design
  ([Terven & Cordova-Esparza 2023](../sources/terven-yolo-survey-2023.md) covers
  it as the NAS entry in the YOLO lineage).
- **Quantization-aware:** designed with quantization-friendly blocks and
  hybrid/INT8 quantization support so accuracy survives compression — the pitch is
  production edge inference.
- **Pretrained** on COCO (plus, per Deci's release, Objects365 and Roboflow100 for
  stronger transfer).
- **Shipped in Ultralytics:** available in the library back-catalog under
  `ultralytics/models/` alongside SAM/FastSAM/RT-DETR
  ([Ultralytics GitHub](../sources/ultralytics-github.md)).

> [!note] No formal paper. YOLO-NAS was released by Deci as an open-source
> model + blog post, not an arXiv paper — so unlike [YOLOv1](../sources/yolo-you-only-look-once-2016.md)
> or [YOLOv10](../sources/yolov10-nms-free-2024.md) there is no primary source to
> ingest; the wiki's knowledge of it comes through the surveys. Its released
> weights also carry a **Deci non-commercial research license** — a deployment
> caveat distinct from Ultralytics' AGPL.
